eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover of bidder (3 years): Rs 9 lakh
3 years past experience supplying same/similar category products to Central/State Govt/PSU

MSE and startup exemption from experience and turnover: Yes
Only Class-I/Class-II local suppliers (Make in India); minimum local content 50% / 20%
Point-by-point technical compliance required; technical deviations only at pre-bid; bids from same IP address rejected; bidders advised to visit the lighthouses
